prompt: When Ivy comes for the bedroom frame, what should she tell the shop?
promptZh: 艾薇改天來領臥室的裱框時，應告訴店家什麼？

options.text: That she needs a new order number for the bedroom frame
options.zh: 需要一個新的訂單號碼才能領臥室那件
options.whyZh: 只領其中一件不會改變其餘裱框的訂單號碼。

options.text: That Ben took the bedroom frame but left the hallway frame
options.zh: 班領走了臥室那件，留下走廊那件
options.whyZh: 兩件的領取安排相反，班只領走廊那件。

options.text: That she wants the bedroom frame under order 618
options.zh: 要領訂單 618 中的臥室裱框
options.whyZh: 班只領走廊那件，臥室那件仍留在原訂單 618。

options.text: That both frames should still be held under order 618
options.zh: 訂單 618 中的兩件都還要留著
options.whyZh: 班會領走走廊那件，店家只需保留另一件。

explanationZh: 班只領走廊那件，臥室那件仍留在原訂單 618。
evidence: The other pieces will stay on the same order, so keep the order number to use again. / Order 618. / Both frames are under that number. Please tell the shop you’re taking just the hallway one.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The other pieces will stay on the same order, so keep the order number to use again.
Both frames are under that number. Please tell the shop you’re taking just the hallway one.

vocabulary.note: 分次領取不會為尚未領走的物品另開訂單。
